Business highlights 
❤Raised 2025 adjusted EPS guidance to a range of $6.30 to $6.40.
We are encouraged by our Enterprise performance and revised outlook in a dynamic environment.Our updated expectations reflect increases in our Health Care Benefits and Pharmacy and Consumer Wellness segments, while recognizing the impact of a higher medical benefit ratio in our Health Care Delivery business. The outlook for our Pharmacy Services business is unchanged.
Updated 2025 guidance continues to reflect our focus on building trust by setting expectations that are appropriate and achievable with opportunities for outperformance.
